Condition : 1 - 8.2	The paving proposed on the Gunnersbury Avenue and Great West Road frontages and around the front of the building is  
?	600mm x 600mm concrete smooth ground paving slabs - Marshall's Perfecta natural finish.
8.3	The paving proposed at the pinnacle of the triangular site, fronting Gunnersbury roundabout, is 600mm x 600mm fibre reinforced textured concrete paving slabs-Marshall's Saxon grey finish.
8.4	Between these two sets of paving stones is 45 degree splayed grey concrete kerb with 75mm drop - Marshall's BS 7263
8.5	The row of bollards around the front of the site are 1100mm black satin finished luminaire bollards - Marshall's MSF 702
description: Following outline approval for erection of 13 storey office building including basement parking and ancillary uses- details pursuant to reserved matters condition 1 (Landscaping) of planning permission 00505/EY/P5 approved 10/09/2002
